svg.desc: Two rankings, A and B, are merged by team draft: in each round a coin decides which ranker picks first and each picks its best item not yet shown. Clicks are credited to the team that picked the item; here A gets two clicks and B none.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Like picking playground teams: each round a coin decides who picks first.

svg.text: One user judges both rankers on the same request, so between-user variance cancels: ~20× fewer users here.
